verdict.rationale: Codegen can run security/secrets scans on PR diffs and post review comments, can trigger agents from CI/CD on build failures, and agents can autonomously create pull requests with code changes. However, there is no direct evidence of ingesting external security alerts (e.g., Dependabot/CodeQL/SCA findings) and automatically validating + remediating them via an opened PR. missing for 10: explicit security-alert ingestion workflow, automated remediation logic tied to alert triage, and any example/case study of alert-to-PR remediation.
